subject: math
checkedBy: Opus build session, against the official PDF: The Ontario Curriculum, Kindergarten, 2026 (version issued December 2025), downloaded from the Ministry site on 2026-10-11. Every code, number range and named shape here matches the PDF's Curriculum at a glance and Expectations by strand.

supportingSources.title: Kindergarten Curriculum (2026): Overall Expectations with Specific Expectations, Kawartha Pine Ridge DSB transcription, retrieved from the Ministry site 5 May 2026
supportingSources.usedFor: Overall expectation titles. Cross-check only. Where it differs from the Ministry page, the Ministry page wins.

expectations.label: Read and write numbers to 20
expectations.note: Paraphrase. The official wording is at sourceUrl.

expectations.label: Tell which group has more, less, or the same
expectations.note: Paraphrase. The official wording is at sourceUrl. The document sets no range here. A maximum of 10 is this app's choice so the groups stay easy to count.

expectations.label: Count to 20 by ones, starting from any number
expectations.note: Paraphrase. The official wording is at sourceUrl.

expectations.label: Compare any two numbers from 0 to 20
expectations.note: Paraphrase. The official wording is at sourceUrl.

expectations.label: Know adding facts up to 5 and the take-away facts that match them
expectations.note: Paraphrase. The official wording is at sourceUrl. Read as sums up to 5 and their matching subtractions.

expectations.label: Carry a pattern on in either direction and find a missing piece
expectations.note: Paraphrase. The official wording is at sourceUrl.

expectations.label: Name and sort common flat shapes
expectations.note: Paraphrase. The official wording is at sourceUrl. The document names circle, hexagon, rhombus and trapezoid. Triangle, square and rectangle are this app's reading of the document's 'most common' shapes.
